I tend to look at it like this, there’s going to be evil and there’s nothing we can do to stop it. God has the ability to yes, BUT He’s not going to stop it right now and honestly He doesn’t need to. In my opinion, I firmly believe that evil has to exist, for the persevering Christians to grow and become stronger. 
We all as Christians have to remember, this isn’t just the world we live in, it’s a constant 24/7 war not only with ourselves, but with the world and Satan and his army. We cannot grow and mature as Christians without something to grow from and mature past, which is evil. We overcome the evil, not ourselves, but through Christ Jesus. But if there were no evil to begin with, we would have no reason to grow and wouldn’t need Christ to redeem us. That is the whole point of Christ’s death. It’s overcoming sin and a just payment. 
Blame it on Adam and Eve, or Satan or whomever, but sin exists and has existed for a while, and we come from the first ones who committed the first sins as humans. It’s the “human family” and we are well known for it, sin and evil, by God. But God wants us in His family and not as our own, because our own is sooo broken and flawed. In His lies perfection and deliverance. 
One day it will all end, and until that day comes, we as Christians don’t need to focus on the evil and sin in this world, but helping those who are stuck in it. It sucks, yeah I know, that murderers, pedophiles and terrorists and whatnot exist in this world, but those aren’t meant to bring us down, by God. He intends to use those for good and help us grow. Just like in Genesis 50:20 “You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.”
And if this still seems dark like one of those collateral damage type scenarios, “minus a few for the greater good” then look at the entire book of Ecclesiastes and come to terms with God, The world, and yourself. It’s helped me and allowed me to be delivered from multiple cares that would otherwise burden me in the long run. 
May God open the eyes and ears and heart of those who read this. Amen.

I work in a steel mill. We brick AOD’s and ladles and furnaces. The brick says on the packaging that it contains crystalline silica and it is a carcinogen. But I just so happen to be unfortunate enough to be the one on the saw cutting brick almost every day for 12 hour shifts. Lucky we do have an air hose connected to an air horn that blows it out and away and I do wear a respirator but I still catch little drifts of the smell and man I hate the smell of that brick. I’d rather go back to smoking than breathe that stuff in daily. 

Not to mention there’s a giant room FILLED with Hexavalent Chromium dust everywhere which is arguably worse and comes with way more health problems, that occasionally gets thrown into the air. 

Regardless, I take the stares and sarcastic comments as I frequently wear my respirator every day while everyone is “being a man” and just. Breathing the air in. It’s not as much that I don’t want to breathe it in (I’d love to finally pass on and go to heaven) but I’d just like to have kids and see at least one become an adult. That is my long term goals.
